thought: running the plan over by the board; everything hangs on the first step
line: Nexus first, then the far chambers. Everything else follows from that.

thought: too many doors to hold for a small force
line: Six chambers, all open to the Nexus. I'd sooner have two.

thought: chalking the Bandos report on the strategy board
line: Goblins with a siege engine. I never thought I'd put that on a board.

thought: still turning over the scout report
line: One scout came back from that lone knight. One, out of a whole squad.

thought: two enemies at each other in the deep tunnels; he's content to let them
line: Skeletons and Zamorakian mages at war in the deep tunnels. Let them.

thought: the demon report bothers him: it isn't like the others
line: A tormented demon that keeps its own flames in hand. That is new.

thought: weighing the Dagon'hai split as news on the board
line: The Dagon'hai have left Lucien. Now they want it all for themselves.

thought: loyal to his commander despite the quirks
line: Armacus is a touch eccentric, but I'd follow him into any cavern.

thought: sizes up the newcomer as fit to take a chamber
line: You've the look of someone who can take a chamber. Good.

thought: short of hands, so a capable newcomer is doubly welcome
line: Good day! We're thin on the ground, so you're doubly welcome.

thought: notices a steady sort; the troops need more like that
line: Steady hands, by the look of you. We could use a few more of those.

thought: the plan's first step, and he backs this one to do it
line: If the Nexus can be taken, I'd wager you're the one to take it.

thought: he brings newcomers up to speed; this one didn't need telling twice
line: Newcomers usually need the plan twice. You had it the first time.

thought: an officer's eye for who's ready, said to the board more than anyone
line: Now there's one ready to deploy. One can always tell.

thought: he knows the plan asks a lot, and respects that it's borne lightly
line: We ask a great deal of you. You don't seem to mind it.

thought: the defence is barely holding, and one more good adventurer counts
line: The line is thin, but it's a deal thicker with you on it.

thought: Armacus vouched for this one; Montoya reserves judgement, politely
line: Armacus is a good judge of character, I'm told. I'll hold him to it.

thought: the plan needs the Nexus taking, and the newcomer is loitering in camp
line: The Nexus is that way, I believe. Not by the bank.

thought: the plan starts with the Nexus, and nobody has gone in yet
line: I've checked the plan twice. The Nexus doesn't take itself.

thought: someone studying the strategy board instead of acting on it
line: Do stop admiring the board. It works better if somebody acts on it.

thought: he briefs newcomers for a living; this one is slow to move
line: I've briefed raw recruits who left the lobby quicker than you.

thought: weighing the enemy against what he's got, with understatement
line: They've a huge ork and a siege engine. We have you, which is a start.

thought: some go to the chambers, some wander the camp
line: Some take a chamber. Some take the scenic route round the lobby.

thought: the plan hangs on the adventurers clearing their side; this one's still here
line: Ah, our adventurer. The plan rather depends on you leaving the lobby.

thought: the Nexus is taken; now the long part begins
line: The Nexus is ours. Holding it is the harder half.

thought: a soldier's regret for the old guardian
line: A shame about the old guardian. It never knew whose side we were on.

thought: Ivy's doubts about Ocellus have gone on his board
line: Ivy doubts Ocellus is truly dead. I've left room on the board for him.

thought: the chambers are still attacked; that hasn't changed
line: Every chamber still comes under attack. The board never gets shorter.

thought: Armacus's cheer is fine, but he'd like proof
line: Armacus says evil is on the back foot. I'd like that in writing.

thought: the daily business of rotating troops
line: Fresh troops in, wounded out. The rota never stops down here.

thought: Moia is still a gap in his intelligence
line: Moia still leads Lucien's forces, and we know little more of her.

thought: the lone knight report still nags at him
line: A whole squad, and a single knight. I still don't like that report.

thought: greets the one who cleared the Nexus
line: Good day! The Nexus holds, and we've you to thank for that.

thought: Armacus judged this one rightly
line: Armacus judged you rightly. He's a good judge, as a rule.

thought: they faced Ocellus and came out; that goes on the board
line: You faced Ocellus in the vault and walked out. That goes on the board.

thought: the troops have opinions, and they're good ones, mostly
line: The troops talk about you, you know. Mostly kindly.

thought: he'd trust this one with any chamber
line: Now there's someone I'd give any chamber to without a second look.

thought: bringing people up to speed is his job; this one comes first
line: When the board changes, you'll be the first I brief.

thought: a reliable adventurer makes an organiser's life easy
line: You make my job easy. Very few people do.

thought: they came back from the inner vault on their feet
line: Still standing after the inner vault, I see. That says a great deal.

thought: the Nexus is taken, but the hero is idling at the bank
line: The Nexus is taken, yes. That's no reason to stand about the bank.

thought: a polite dig at Armacus's judgement of this one
line: Armacus is a good judge of character. He has his off days, of course.

thought: Ocellus keeps after the Blade; this one keeps after the bank
line: Ocellus keeps after the Blade, and you keep after the bank.

thought: the chambers still need defending; the adventurer is back in camp
line: Back again? The chambers don't defend themselves, you understand.

thought: plenty of heroes stop for a chat; fewer go in
line: Every hero in the lobby wants a word. Few want a chamber.

thought: taking it was the start; defending it is the job
line: You took the Nexus, splendid. The defending part comes after.

thought: the builders are busy with bridges, not celebrations
line: If you're waiting for a parade, the builders haven't built one.

thought: a hero settling in too comfortably
line: Some adventurers rest on their laurels. You've brought a cushion.

thought: everything in the lobby goes in the records, grandly
line: Every step in this lobby goes in the records. Every... single... one.

thought: has mislaid the page he needs
line: Where's the page on the alliance's progress got to? It was just here.

thought: still smarting at being called 'a' record keeper
line: People call me 'a' record keeper. As if there were others!

thought: the alliance is struggling, and the records agree
line: The alliance is struggling, say the records. They are rarely wrong.

thought: guards the pages, then realises nobody was near them
line: Hands off the pages! Ah, you weren't touching them at all.

thought: thought he heard someone ask; absent-minded
line: Was someone asking about the records? I was sure someone was.

thought: the archive's secrets are in these pages, somewhere
line: The archive's secrets, all in these pages. Somewhere in these pages.

thought: his apprentice is off at the crystals again
line: My apprentice is at those crystals again. He'd better be taking notes.

thought: a new adventurer means a new page
line: Ah, Aspirant. The records have a fresh page, just for you.

thought: muttering approval over a promising entry
line: A promising entry, this one. Very promising, I shall underline it.

thought: the records watch the Aspirant; so, he thinks, does he
line: Aspirant! The records are very keen on you, and so am I, I think.

thought: the player's doings are piling up in his pages, which stay shut
line: Your page is filling up nicely. No, you may not see it.

thought: this one will give the records plenty
line: There goes one the records will want a great deal more of.

thought: a hunch the record will be a kind one
line: I've a feeling the records will be kind to you. They aren't to all.

thought: the alliance struggles, and here comes help; he likes the sentence
line: The alliance struggles, and in walks the Aspirant! I'll write that.

thought: he records every step, and these are good ones
line: Such purposeful steps. Those will look splendid on the page.

thought: the player's page is still thin
line: Your page is mostly blank, Aspirant. Mostly.

thought: the records were expecting the Aspirant sooner
line: The records expected the Aspirant days ago. Still, here you are.

thought: he writes down dawdling too
line: Dawdling, noted. The records are very thorough, Aspirant.

thought: someone too near his pages
line: Don't read over my shoulder! Your own page is dull enough.

thought: the alliance struggles while the records note a bank trip
line: The alliance is struggling, and the records say you went to the bank.

thought: a short entry, shorter than his own notes to himself
line: A short entry, yours, Aspirant. I've written longer notes to myself.

thought: many arrive as Aspirants; few last
line: Another Aspirant. They do keep coming, and very few keep going.

thought: absent-minded enough to doubt who's walking past
line: Ah, the Aspirant! At least, I'm fairly sure it's the Aspirant.

thought: the taking of the Nexus needed extra pages
line: A busy chapter in the records, the Nexus. I've had to add pages.

thought: writing up a guardian's title and stuck on the spelling
line: Ocellus, Guardian of Ascension. Now how is that spelt...

thought: fond of the cape engraving as a word for his own trade
line: Scrivener, the first defenders' cape says. Now that's a word I like.

thought: the Blade seems to move by itself, which spoils his sketching
line: I'd swear that Blade moved while I was writing it up.

thought: every defence of the archive adds a line
line: Every defence of the archive, one more line in the records.

thought: he keeps the progress, if not in order
line: I keep the alliance's progress. I don't always keep it in order.

thought: Guthix's guardians each get a page, one gets more
line: Guthix's guardians, a page each. Ocellus gets two, and a warning.

thought: the vault relics need cataloguing, and the mask unnerves him
line: The vault's relics want cataloguing. That mask keeps looking at me.

thought: the player's deeds have outgrown their page
line: Aspirant! Your page has grown so, I've had to sew another in.

thought: the Nexus and the vault will be told of a long while
line: The Nexus, the vault... the records will talk of you for ages.

thought: Ocellus faced, and the Aspirant still here: a good entry
line: Ocellus himself, and the Aspirant still standing. A fine entry.

thought: a rare honour from a fussy curator
line: I've underlined your name. I never underline anything.

thought: the archivists' cape is meant for defenders like this
line: That old archivists' cape is made for the likes of you, Aspirant.

thought: a busy record is a happy record
line: You've given the records a good deal to do. They're delighted.

thought: absent-minded: tells himself to write down what he already wrote
line: There goes the one who took the Nexus. Write that down... oh, I did.

thought: nobody reads his pages, but this one nearly could
line: Nobody reads my pages. For you I'd nearly make an exception.

thought: from the vault to the bank queue
line: Faced Ocellus in the vault, and now you're in the bank queue. Noted.

thought: defending the archive again and again makes for a samey page
line: Your page is long now, Aspirant. Long and, in places, repetitive.

thought: every visit costs him ink
line: Another visit, another line. I'm running out of ink on you.

thought: the records like the player more than he does
line: The records are impressed. I'm reserving judgement.

thought: another trip through the archive, probably like the last
line: Back for another chapter, Aspirant? Not the same as the last, I hope.

thought: what he wrote by the player's name, with a doubt
line: I wrote 'heroic' by your name. Then I added a question mark.

thought: the guardian couldn't tell friend from foe; he half sympathises
line: The guardian couldn't tell friend from foe. Looking at you, I see why.

thought: someone peering at the pages
line: Do stop trying to read your own entry. It's upside down from there.

thought: the sprites still thrill him
line: Strike a crystal and the magic can gather into a sprite! Wonderful!

thought: caught the roots retreating, wants it noted
line: Did the roots just pull back? They did, somebody write that down!

thought: sprites vanish into crystal the moment they're noticed
line: Sprites go to crystal the moment anyone looks. Awfully hard to study.

thought: the question he's here to answer
line: Do the roots think? That's the question, the whole question!

thought: a worked rock sank and another rose
line: That rock's sunk, and another's come up over there. Marvellous!

thought: the crystals soak up the archive's stray magic
line: Every crystal down here is soaking up stray magic. Every one!

thought: his master records people; he records rocks
line: The Record Keeper writes down what people do. I do the rocks.

thought: dense with magic and everyone just hits them
line: Thick with magic, those rocks, and all anyone does is hit them.

thought: anyone mining is feeding his research
line: Hello there! Mine as much as you like, you're helping the research!

thought: each sprite shaken loose is a new note
line: Every sprite you shake loose is another note for me. Thank you!

thought: this one looks curious; most don't
line: You look like someone who'd find a sprite interesting. Most don't!

thought: spots a fellow curious mind by how they look at the rocks
line: Oh, a curious one! You look at the crystals properly, I can tell.

thought: insists the miner keeps the rocks
line: Keep whatever you dig up. You've earned it, and it's thick with magic!

thought: muttering admiration to nobody
line: There goes a natural scientist, if ever I saw one.

thought: helping the alliance and the research in one go
line: You're helping the alliance and my research at the same time!

thought: the roots retreat as crystals are broken; credits the player
line: Thanks to you the roots have pulled back twice today. Twice!

thought: someone strolls past the most exciting rocks there are
line: You walked right past the crystals! The finest rocks in Gielinor!

thought: corrects a mistake the player probably never made
line: It's not a ghost, it's a sprite! An easy mistake, for a non-wizard.

thought: adventurers see loot, not science
line: Most adventurers see a crystal and think 'loot'. You too, I expect.

thought: bored faces in front of magic rocks
line: Do you have to look so bored? These rocks are full of magic!

thought: noticing a sprite turns it to crystal; the player spoiled one
line: You noticed the sprite, didn't you? That's why it's crystal now.

thought: adventurers are strong and incurious
line: Adventurers! All muscle and no curiosity, most of them.

thought: assumes the player is about to offer him rocks again
line: Trying to give me rocks again, aren't you? I can see it in your face.

thought: everyone's always just passing his crystals
line: Just passing, are you? Everyone's always just passing the crystals.

thought: wonders whether the Blade's power reaches the lobby crystals
line: Does the Blade's power reach this far? The crystals might tell me.

thought: his notes have grown; his master guards pages jealously
line: Pages and pages on these crystals now. The Record Keeper's jealous.

thought: the roots let one rock sink; he wonders how
line: The roots let that one sink. I wonder if they choose which.

thought: he's learnt not to stare at sprites
line: Sprites turn to crystal when they're noticed, so I've stopped staring.

thought: tried asking the roots directly
line: I asked the roots a question today. No answer yet, but I'll try again.

thought: the whole archive's stray magic ends up in these crystals
line: Stray magic from the whole archive ends up in these crystals. Imagine!

thought: heard of a mask in the vault that seems to move
line: There's a mask in the vault that moves, they say. Oh, to see it!

thought: everyone mines and nobody writes it down
line: Everyone mines the crystals, and nobody writes anything down but me!

thought: the one who took the Nexus; he wants to study them too
line: You're the one who took the Nexus! Might I take a few notes on you?

thought: this one has been near the Blade; he's dying to know
line: You've been near the Blade, haven't you? Did it feel like anything?

thought: still curious after the vault: his favourite kind of person
line: Still curious about crystals, even after the vault! My favourite sort.

thought: unscientific hunch that the crystals like this one
line: The crystals seem livelier when you're about. Unscientific, but true!

thought: holding the archive kept his research going
line: You held the archive, and my research with it! Thank you!

thought: they faced Ocellus and still bother with his crystals
line: There's the one who faced Ocellus, and still has time for my crystals!

thought: sprites can't be held still, but if anyone could
line: If I ever need someone to hold a sprite still, I'll ask you first!

thought: would make a fine apprentice, he thinks
line: You've a scientist's patience. Ever thought of an apprenticeship?

thought: brave against Ocellus, wary of a sprite
line: You stood up to Ocellus, and you're frightened of a sprite?

thought: still hitting crystals with no science at all
line: Took the Nexus, and you still hit crystals like they owe you money!

thought: the Blade's in the vault, and they ask about rocks
line: The Blade's in the vault, and you're out here asking me about rocks?

thought: heroes never wonder why anything glows
line: Heroes! Always rushing about, never once wondering why anything glows.

thought: they saw the vault and took no notes
line: You've seen the inner vault and didn't take a single note? Not one?

thought: study versus smashing
line: Some study the archive. Others just hit it until it gives up shards.

thought: keep the rocks: he's seen what the player does to things
line: Keep the rocks, honestly. I've seen what you do to things.

thought: they want shards and no explanation
line: Another adventurer at my crystals, after shards and not one question.

thought: she's looked at the cavern from every side already
line: I've admired this cavern from every angle now. All of them stone.

thought: would like the alliance to camp somewhere green for once
line: Just once I'd like the alliance to camp somewhere with a meadow.

thought: lost her place in the old book
line: Now, where was I? Somewhere in the Second Age, I think.

thought: the belongings are safe; it's their owners she worries for
line: Everyone's things are here, safe. It's the people I worry about.

thought: all this crystal and no flowers
line: A cavern full of crystal and not one flower. It's a shame, really.

thought: the alliance has only just arrived; standing about comes later
line: Still unpacking the bank boxes. Then comes the standing about.

thought: the roots round the rocks are the nearest thing to a garden
line: The roots round those crystals are the closest thing to a garden here.

thought: likes seeing the world, just not the bottom of it
line: I like seeing the world. I'd just like to see more of the top of it.

thought: a customer back unhurt, which is how she likes them
line: Oh, hello! Back in one piece, which is how I like my customers.

thought: they go into danger so she can stand about
line: You go where it's dangerous so the rest of us can stand about. Thanks.

thought: she values quiet, and this customer is quiet
line: Quiet customers are my favourite. You're one of the nice quiet ones.

thought: someone choosing to come somewhere this dangerous
line: It's nice to see someone come down here on purpose. Brave of you.

thought: thinks they'd like her poem, won't read it out
line: You'd like this poem, I think. No, I won't read it out, but you would.

thought: the defence is barely holding and needs this sort
line: Mind how you go in there. The alliance needs people like you.

thought: the best thing she's seen all shift
line: Oh, it's you. That's the nicest thing to walk past all morning.

thought: a tidy bank is a banker's joy
line: A traveller who keeps their bank tidy. I could weep, honestly.

thought: she'd only just settled in to her quiet
line: Back so soon? The cavern and I were just getting comfortable.

thought: coming somewhere this dangerous for the views
line: Danger everywhere, and you've come down for the scenery, I expect.

thought: her poems aren't about adventurers, luckily
line: If you're after a poem, I've none about adventurers. Thankfully.

thought: she followed the alliance down so they'd have their things
line: I came all this way so you'd have your things. Do try to use them.

thought: a long bank fiddle, and she has a long poem
line: Take your time in your bank. I've a long poem on the go.

thought: another adventurer who never reads
line: Another adventurer who's never read a book. Still, you're welcome.

thought: the defence is barely holding and they're at the bank
line: You do know the defence is barely holding? Of course you do, carry on.

thought: always in a hurry, never stopping
line: Do come and visit when you're not in a hurry. Some day, perhaps.

thought: settled now, the hardest choice is which poem
line: Now we're settled, the hardest part of my day is choosing a poem.

thought: the old book has lasted well
line: Thought to be from the Second Age, this book. It's held up well.

thought: hopes the next destination has a garden
line: Wherever the alliance goes next, I do hope it has a garden.

thought: all those reward chests and still a queue at the bank
line: All those chests of rewards, and still everybody queues at my bank.

thought: heard of the Blade, would rather a book
line: A broken Blade in the vault, they say. I'd rather a good book.

thought: no weeds anywhere: too tidy for her
line: Not a weed in this whole cavern. I find that rather sad.

thought: wry understatement about the neighbours
line: Quiet today. Only the odd demon, by all accounts.

thought: the alliance always picks dangerous places
line: The alliance always picks somewhere dangerous. I've stopped asking.

thought: the player made the lobby safer to read in
line: Oh, hello. You're the one who made this place safe enough to read in.

thought: the Nexus is held and she can almost hear herself read
line: Thank you for the Nexus. I can almost hear myself read now.

thought: their things ready, the least she can do after the vault
line: Your things, ready as ever. The least I can do after the vault.

thought: if anyone wrote a poem about this place
line: If they ever write a poem about this place, I hope you're in it.

thought: hears praise of the player at the counter
line: You've done the alliance proud. I hear it from all at the counter.

thought: quietly impressed, said to nobody
line: There goes the one who held the archive, and so quietly. I like that.

thought: long days standing about, and this one brightens them
line: Good to see you. It's a long day standing about, and you brighten it.

thought: people like this make following the alliance worth it
line: It's people like you who make following the alliance about worthwhile.

thought: held the Nexus, can't keep a tidy bank
line: Held the Nexus, and still you can't keep a tidy bank.

thought: chests of rewards, and they bring her clutter
line: All those reward chests, and you still bring me your clutter.

thought: she'd only just found her page
line: Back again? I'd only just found my page.

thought: would recommend a book but has seen their bank
line: I'd recommend a book, but I've seen how you treat your bank.

thought: always rushing; the cavern isn't going anywhere
line: Such a hurry, always. The cavern will still be here, you know.

thought: heroes never read
line: Heroes never seem to read. Too busy hitting things, I suppose.

thought: they saw off Ocellus; needn't see off her patience
line: You've seen off Ocellus. You needn't see off my patience too.

thought: they keep coming back down here; they must like danger
line: Another trip down the chasm? You must like danger more than I do.
